I have not yet added this non-monetary instruction to the intake form, so it is not reflected in the current draft demand. Given the supplier's termination threat and the timeline we are working under, we need to incorporate these equitable remedies into the demand before the litigation director approves it.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Incorporate the ICDR arbitration forum, New York seat, and three-arbitrator panel requirement into the demand package per the executed schedule.

Add equitable relief requests: restoration of access to the implementation environment, return or destruction of client source code, and confidentiality protections, per client general counsel's instructions.
Update the direct-damages claim to $2,400,000 per the finalized invoice reconciliation and credits analysis.

Conflicts clearance memo must be issued confirming scope of prior representation; informed written consent from the supplier-side client must be obtained and an ethical screen installed before the affected lawyer may participate.
Litigation Director approval will be granted once all of the above revisions and clearances are completed and documented.
